label: Non-locality
text: PH.O.A2.2 Non-locality. Bell: any local hidden-variable theory with measurement independence obeys the CHSH bound S ≤ 2. Quantum mechanics reaches 2√2 (the Tsirelson bound). Loophole-free violations were reported in 2015 (Delft, Vienna, NIST).

warrant.standard: controlled experiment with quoted uncertainty; replication; 5σ for discovery claims in particle physics
